Interface OwnerScope

All Known Implementing Classes:
OwnerScope.Primary, OwnerScope.Sub, OwnerScope.Tab
public sealed interface OwnerScope permits OwnerScope.Primary, OwnerScope.Tab, OwnerScope.Sub
Namespaces an owner-coordinate when a bare (family, index) would alias — the disambiguation tool inside a RootOwner.

The two collision sources (kept distinct on purpose)

Two genuinely-unlike sources can make the same flat index mean different things; they are namespaced here but are NOT asserted to share a source:
  • OwnerScope.Tab — the active creative tab. The creative menu rebuilds its slot list per selected tab, so index 5 means different content per tab. Source: BuiltInRegistries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB.getKey( CreativeModeInventoryScreen.selectedTab) (a stable Identifier). The discriminator lives on the SCREEN, not the menu, so Tab is CLIENT-tier-only — a server-tier address must never carry a tab scope.
  • OwnerScope.Sub — a composite/multi-backing menu (double chest, furnace segments). Source: the stable per-backing id from §0050 composite resolution (ResolvedSlot.key()), adapted to an MK-safe string at the (MKC) mint site.

Sealed-extensible

New scopes are additive; handlers treat this non-exhaustively. The two sources stay separate constructors rather than one merged "scope id" so a future collision source can be added without conflating it with these.
